items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: I was taught by Valerie. ... She was my teacher.

ctx.x: By the way, where did you take lessons? And who was your teacher? Did your father help you any?
Oh, my father helped me, yes. To learn to read music. But I was taught by Valerie. Boy, she's dead. She was my teacher. And, uh, well, you know, he used to give me hints.
Did you ever play in any orchestras when you were younger?
